reviews.author: shaylahc1
reviews.text: Champion installed a fence for me in 2018. We were having some issues with the gates they installed. The owner, Vann, came to my door and asked how he could help. They ended up replacing the gates free of charge. That is what I call excellent customer service. Thank you so much! I really appreciate the hard work you and your team put in.

reviews.author: Billy Moore
reviews.text: Top-notch professional service. Great communicators, mediators between difficult HOA. Much gratitude to entire team, but some team members deserve honorable mention, ie Bryant Furr, consultant; Brandon provided detailed outline of property for fencing, Elizabeth provided effective and efficient scheduling and explained anything challenges accessing materials, provided options . And finally, yet not least of all much gratitude to the 3-member Latino installation team , Antonio, Tony, as they were results focused, precise, detailed and organized. It was great chatting with them, sharing coffee and bagels with cream cheese and hearing them converse in Spanish. Beautiful experience.
